prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1055
Claimant:
Blake White
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
8-10-25
Received first notice of loss from the claimant, who reports bieng struck while turning left at an intersection. The
claimant is not represented by an attorney and describes neck and back strain following the impact.
8-11-25
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the incident. Nothing in the
file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
10-9-25
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the scene. Responding officers and a
witness statement are consistent with the claimant's location.
11-18-25
Claimant gave a recorded statement describing the sequence of events. The account matched the one given during
first notice and was consistent in every conversation so far.
11-27-25
Photos from the scene confirm the general point of impact and the vehicle positions. No independent witnesses have
come forward beyond those listed in the police report.
12-12-25
Inspected the vehicle. A few old scratches are visible on the rear panel that may predate this collision, and I have
noted them separately for the appraiser.
1-9-26
Medical records show the reported neck and back strain. The kind and force of the impact appear well mathced to
these injuries.
1-10-26
Reviewed the treatment history. Care followed a typical course and tapered as the claimant's condition improved. No
prior injury to the same body areas is known from the records obtained.
1-14-26
Appraiser notes it is not yet clear whether all of the listed damage resulted from this impact. The estimate is on hold
pending a closer look at the older marks.
1-19-26
Spoke again with the claimant, who repeated the same account of the turning collision without changes. No new
information was offered that alters the file.
1-30-26
Currnet status: liability and coverage are being reviewed together with medical treatment progress. Next step is to
finalize the damage split once the appraiser's supplemental report is received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
